name: Song-Kul Lake
description: High-altitude lake, summer pastures, yurt stays, walking, and horse-riding routes.

name: Issyk-Kul Lake
description: A large mountain lake with contrasting north and south shores, villages, canyons, and access to Karakol.

name: Ala-Archa
description: Mountain valley close to Bishkek with options ranging from relaxed walks to demanding hikes.

name: Burana Tower
description: Historic minaret and archaeological landscape connected with the medieval Chui Valley.

name: Karakol
description: Eastern lake town used as a base for regional culture, food, valleys, and trekking routes.

name: Skazka Canyon
description: Eroded red-rock landscape on the southern side of Issyk-Kul, suitable for a short scenic walk.

name: Tash-Rabat
description: Historic stone caravanserai in an Inner Tien Shan valley, often combined with Naryn routes.

name: Peak Lenin Base Camp
description: High-mountain landscape in the Alay area for acclimatization walks and expedition-style routes.
